title: In situ capture of combinatorial neuromodulatory codes
title_zh: 原位捕获组合神经调节代码
abstract: In this Tools of the Trade article, Peter Kalugin discusses the development of multiplexed optical recording of sensors on a micro-endoscope (MORSE) to track combinatorial hormone, neurotransmitter, and neuromodulator signals on the spatial and temporal scale of neural activity.
abstract_zh: 在本期 Tools of the Trade 文章中，彼得·卡卢金讨论了多重光学传感器在微型内窥镜（MORSE）上的开发，以追踪神经活动空间和时间尺度上组合激素、神经递质和神经调节信号。
